olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: An $(a+b+1)\times(a+b+1)$ grid colored amber and bronze with $\geq a^2+ab-b$ amber and $\geq b^2+ab-a$ bronze cells. Prove one can choose $a$ amber and $b$ bronze cells with no two in the same row or column.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2022

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $2b$ black rods and $2w$ white rods (each length 1) assemble into a regular $2n$-gon ($n=b+w$) with parallel sides the same color. Black rods form convex $2b$-gon $B$; white form $2w$-gon $W$. Prove the difference of areas of $B$ and $W$ depends only on $b,w$.
figure_description: Assembly diagram for b=3, w=2 with resulting polygons B and W
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2022

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Find all pairs of primes $(p,q)$ for which $p-q$ and $pq-q$ are both perfect squares.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2022

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ is essentially increasing if $f(s)\leq f(t)$ whenever $s\leq t$ and $f(s)\neq 0\neq f(t)$. Find the smallest $k$ such that any 2022 reals $x_1,\ldots,x_{2022}$ can be written as $f_1(n)+\cdots+f_k(n)=x_n$ for essentially increasing $f_i$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2022

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: 2022 users on Mathbook; a new friendship forms iff the two users have $\geq 2$ mutual friends. Find the minimum number of initial friendships so that eventually all users can become friends.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2022
